skill_path: Start by building caregiving and light-housekeeping skills through entry-level roles like home health aide or caregiver, which also provide meal-prep and transportation experience. Look for positions at home care agencies or assisted living facilities to gain hands-on patient interaction. Once you have 6-12 months of experience, pursue a Medical Assistant certification or CNA training to formalize your skills and advance toward nursing.
